Package Data

Class Waitlist_Repository

java.lang.Object
Data.Waitlist_Repository
public class Waitlist_Repository extends Object
This class handles all database operations related to the Waitlist. It manages how customers join the line and how they are matched to tables.

    • isCustomerAlreadyInWaitlist

      public boolean isCustomerAlreadyInWaitlist(String phone, String email)
      Checks if a customer is already in the waitlist using their contact details. Only looks for entries with a 'WAITING' status.
      Parameters:
      phone - Customer's phone number.
      email - Customer's email address.
      Returns:
      true if the customer is already waiting, false otherwise.

      newStatus - The new status string to apply.
      Returns:

    • markAsNotified

      public void markAsNotified(int waitlistId)
      Sets the status of a waitlist entry to 'NOTIFIED' and records the current time. Used when a table becomes free for the customer.
      Parameters:
      waitlistId - The ID of the waitlist entry.

    • findFirstMatch

      public Waitlist findFirstMatch(int tableCapacity)
      Finds the next customer in line whose group size fits the released table. It checks Priority waiting (PWAITING) first, then regular waiting (WAITING).
      Parameters:
      tableCapacity - The number of seats available at the free table.
      Returns:
      A Waitlist object representing the best match, or null.

    • getExpiredNotifiedWaitlists

      public List<Waitlist> getExpiredNotifiedWaitlists(int minutes)
      Retrieves a list of waitlist entries that were notified but did not show up in time.
      Parameters:
      minutes - The grace period allowed before the entry is considered expired.
      Returns:
      A list of Waitlist objects that have exceeded the time limit.

    • getAllActiveWaitlists

      public List<Map<String,Object>> getAllActiveWaitlists()
      Retrieves all active waitlist entries for management and display. Includes information from both the Waitlist and Reservations tables.
      Returns:
      A list of Maps, each representing an active entry with details like confirmation code and status.
